concepts: Getting started (Claude Code): Overview, Quickstart, Claude Code changelog.

Use Claude Code: How Claude remembers your project, Manage sessions, Common workflows, Prompt library, Best practices for Claude Code.

Platforms and integrations: Platforms and integrations, Continue local sessions from any device with Remote Control, Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects, Claude Code on mobile, Use Claude Code with Chrome, Let Claude use your computer from the CLI, Use Claude Code in VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, Claude Code in Slack, Claude Tag.
Claude Code in the cloud: Get started with Claude Code in the cloud, Use Claude Code in the cloud, Automate work with scheduled tasks.

Claude Code on desktop: Get started with the desktop app, Desktop application, Claude Desktop on Linux (beta), Claude Code Desktop in WSL, Schedule recurring tasks in Claude Code Desktop, Test iOS apps in the simulator.

Run Claude in your own CI
Run Claude in your own CI: Claude Code GitHub Actions, Use Claude Code GitHub Actions with cloud providers, Claude Code GitLab CI/CD.
skills: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools. Available in your terminal, IDE, desktop app, and browser.
Install Claude Code in your terminal, sign in, and use the CLI to explore your codebase and make your first code change.
Release notes for Claude Code, including new features, improvements, and bug fixes by version.
Understand the agentic loop, built-in tools, and how Claude Code interacts with your project.
Understand when to use CLAUDE.md, Skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, and plugins.

Where Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, settings.json, hooks, skills, commands, subagents, workflows, rules, and auto memory. Explore the .claude directory in your project and ~/.claude in your home directory.
An interactive simulation of how Claude Code's context window fills during a session. See what loads automatically, what each file read costs, and when rules and hooks fire.
How Claude Code uses prompt caching
See why a model switch triggers a slow uncached turn in Claude Code, what /compact costs, and how to check your prompt cache hit rate.
Give Claude persistent instructions with CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md files, and let Claude accumulate learnings automatically with auto memory.

Name, resume, branch, and switch between Claude Code conversations. Covers --continue, --resume, --from-pr, the /resume picker, session naming, exporting transcripts, and where transcripts are stored.
Step-by-step guides for exploring codebases, fixing bugs, refactoring, testing, and other everyday tasks with Claude Code.
Copy-paste prompts for Claude Code, tagged by task and role.
Get more out of Claude Code: tell Claude what it can't see, give it a check to run, and enforce the rules that can't have exceptions.
Choose where to run Claude Code and what to connect it to. Compare the CLI, Desktop, VS Code, JetBrains, web, mobile, and integrations like Chrome, Slack, and CI/CD.
Continue local sessions from any device with Remote Control
Continue a local Claude Code session from your phone, tablet, or any browser using Remote Control. Works with claude.ai/code and the Claude mobile app.
Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
Hand Claude a stream of related tasks in one conversation and let it run them as parallel cloud sessions that share repositories, instructions, and memory.
Start, monitor, and steer Claude Code tasks from your phone with the Claude app for iOS and Android.
Connect Claude Code to your Chrome browser to test web apps, debug with console logs, automate form filling, and extract data from web pages.
Let Claude use your computer from the CLI

Enable computer use in the Claude Code CLI so Claude can open apps, click, type, and see your screen on macOS. Test native apps, debug visual issues, and automate GUI-only tools without leaving your terminal.
Use Claude Code in VS Code
Install and configure the Claude Code extension for VS Code. Get AI coding assistance with inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and keyboard shortcuts.
Use Claude Code with JetBrains IDEs including IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, and more
What to use in place of the earlier Claude Code in Slack, on Team, Enterprise, Pro, Max, and Ultra plans.
Bring Claude into your team's Slack channels with Claude Tag and find its setup and usage documentation on claude.com.
Get started with Claude Code in the cloud
Run Claude Code in the cloud from your browser or phone. Connect a GitHub repository, submit a task, and review the PR without local setup.
Use Claude Code in the cloud
Run Claude Code sessions in the cloud from your browser, phone, Desktop app, or terminal, move them with --cloud and --teleport, and auto-fix pull requests.
Put Claude Code on autopilot. Create scheduled tasks, formerly routines, that run in the cloud on a schedule, on API calls, or on GitHub events.
Get started with the desktop app
Install the Claude desktop app, open the Code tab, and start your first Claude Code session on a project folder on your computer.

Get more out of Claude Code Desktop: parallel sessions with Git isolation, drag-and-drop pane layout, integrated terminal and file editor, side chats, computer use, Dispatch sessions from your phone, visual diff review, app previews, PR monitoring, connectors, and enterprise configuration.
Install and update the Claude desktop app on Ubuntu and Debian
Run Code sessions inside a WSL 2 distribution on Windows
Schedule recurring tasks in Claude Code Desktop
Set up scheduled tasks in Claude Code Desktop to run Claude automatically on a recurring basis for daily code reviews, dependency audits, or morning briefings.
Test iOS apps in the simulator
Claude Code Desktop opens your app in the iOS Simulator pane when Claude builds, runs, or checks it.
Run /code-review in a Claude Code session to find bugs in your branch's changes, point the review at a pull request or path, and have Claude apply the fixes.
Run a deep, multi-agent code review in the cloud with /code-review ultra to find and verify bugs before you merge.
Claude Code with GitHub Enterprise Server
Connect Claude Code to your self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server instance for cloud sessions, code review, and plugin marketplaces.
Catch bugs in GitHub pull requests with Code Review: Claude reviews each change, verifies its findings, and comments inline. For Team and Enterprise plans
Turn on Code Review for your Claude organization: connect GitHub, install the Claude GitHub App, choose repositories, and set when reviews run
Tune what Code Review flags on your pull requests with REVIEW.md and CLAUDE.md: recalibrate severity, skip paths, add checks, and see which copy applies.
Read and request reviews on a pull request
Read Code Review findings on your GitHub pull request, respond to or dismiss them, and request a review with @claude review.
Estimate and cap what your organization spends on Claude Code Review: how reviews are billed through usage credits, what drives cost, and where to track usage.
Fix a Code Review that didn't start, failed, or was skipped for budget, find missing findings, and resolve setup and REVIEW.md problems.
Catch security issues as Claude writes code
Install the security-guidance plugin to have Claude review its own code changes for vulnerabilities and fix them in the same session.
Install the Claude Security plugin to scan your codebase for vulnerabilities in a Claude Code session and turn findings into patches you review and apply.
Run Claude Code in GitHub Actions workflows to respond to @claude mentions, automate tasks, and turn issues into pull requests
Use Claude Code GitHub Actions with cloud providers
Run Claude Code GitHub Actions through Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, or Microsoft Foundry instead of the Claude API
Learn about integrating Claude Code into your development workflow with GitLab CI/CD
